[EN] Mission Orders

Prions and hyenas in Feldrin Ravine are menacing locals.

Kill the {@LinkCreature:38#31#hungry ruins hyenas}, {@LinkCreature:38#38#prion destroyers} and {@LinkCreature:38#37#bonecrushers}.

Report to Slevene when mission is complete.
[ES] Orden de misión

Los Prions y las hienas en Feldrin Ravine están atemorizando a los lugareños.

Mata a {@LinkCreature:38#31#hungry ruins hyenas}, {@LinkCreature:38#38#prion destroyers} y {@LinkCreature:38#37#bonecrushers}.

Informa a Slevene cuando la misión esté completa.
